title: Warplyn — Open-source writing workspace with AI assistance
description: Warplyn is an open-source, local-first writing workspace for Windows and Linux. Write and revise your Articles, with an AI Editorial Assistant when you want help.
socialImage: Warplyn desktop workspace with an Article and an Editorial Assistant revision request.
schemaDescription: Open-source, local-first writing workspace. Develop and revise Articles with optional AI assistance from the Editorial Assistant, and review proposed changes before applying them.
intro: Warplyn is an open-source, local-first writing workspace for Windows and Linux. Write and revise your Articles, with an AI Editorial Assistant when you want help. You decide what changes.
free: Always open source · Free features stay free
illustration: Illustration of Warplyn's article editor and proposal review
sceneLabel: A writing space that leaves the last word to you
sampleOpening: The river carried its own light that evening—a slow silver threading through the willows.
sampleAna: Ana had walked this path a hundred times, but tonight the current seemed deliberate, as though it recognized her watching.
sampleSelection: She sat on the bank and opened her notebook.
sampleEnding: The page stayed blank. Sometimes the right word does not come with patience.
suggestion: A small suggestion for this passage.
sampleProposal: She settled on the riverbank and opened her notebook.
sceneCaption: The original stays yours. Keep only the edits you want.
localArticles: Your Articles stay on this computer
chooseEdits: You choose which edits to accept
featuresIntro: Warplyn helps with the work around writing. Your voice and judgment stay at the center.
draftBody: Bring a few points, a premise, or a rough outline. Ask the Assistant to help you shape them into a draft.
reviseBody: Work on flow, structure, or style. Review proposed edits before accepting them into your Article.
checkBody: Get sourced Findings to help you assess claims. Fact checks are advice, not a guarantee of accuracy.
translateBody: Prepare a translation as a separate linked Article. Your original stays intact while you review it.
historyBody: Save Revisions, return to earlier work, and keep the history that came after it. Drafts autosave as recovery checkpoints.
shareBody: Check your Article against length guidance, then copy it as Markdown or plain text to the platform you choose.
storage: Articles, drafts, and Revision history live in Warplyn’s local SQLite database. Warplyn doesn’t run a sync service or upload your writing.
providerPrivacy: When you ask the Editorial Assistant for help, Warplyn sends the relevant text and context to the AI provider you chose. The provider’s data policies apply.
localDatabase: Your data stays in your local Warplyn database.
providerBody: Connect a supported AI provider with your API key. Choose a model that fits your work and budget; available operations depend on its capabilities.
providerCatalog: OpenCode Zen also lets you use models from additional providers in its catalog. Available operations depend on the chosen model.
providerCost: AI features need an internet connection. Your provider may charge separately for its service.
closingBody: Download Warplyn and make the workspace yours.
motto: Your writing. Your voice. Your agent.
footerPrivacy: Your writing stays on your computer.
